keySentence: Real courage is doing what is right even when afraid.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim took back the ship! 🎉 He was brave all by himself. Everyone was amazed. Real courage is doing what is right even when afraid.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim successfully recaptured the Hispaniola all by himself! He defeated the two pirates and moved the ship to a safe spot. The captain and doctor were amazed by Jim's incredible bravery. Jim humbly said he was just lucky. Real courage is doing what is right even when afraid. But everyone knew it was pure courage that saved them all.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Against all odds, Jim managed to recapture the Hispaniola single-handedly! He outsmarted the two pirates and carefully moved the ship to a hidden, safe location. When Jim returned to his friends, they could hardly believe what he had accomplished. The captain shook Jim's hand and declared him the hero of the entire expedition. Real courage is doing what is right even when afraid. However, Jim remained humble and said fortune had been on his side. Because Jim had the courage to act alone when no one else could, the whole group was saved. This adventure proved that true courage is doing the right thing even when nobody is watching.

choice: even when or what is right?
